title: The Use of Inflammatory Markers to Guide Therapy in Children With Severe Asthma
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to determine whether using non-invasive measurements of airway inflammation can improve clinical decision making in children with severe asthma compared to conventional management (British Thoracic Society Guidelines)
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

Children \>8 years with severe asthma defined as:

Taking at least 500mcg fluticasone propionate (or equivalent) per day, plus a long acting beta agonist plus a leukotriene antagonist or previous trial

Exclusion Criteria:

Children taking steroid sparing agent (cyclosporin, azathioprine, methotrexate) Children with other major respiratory diagnoses such as bronchiectasis
